correctness.rationale: The theorem consistently uses the 32 cube edges as metric points, inclusive d_L<=r and all real r>=0. The explicit endpoint metric and BFS show diameter four with exactly sixteen disjoint antipodal pairs. At r=1 the cover by sixteen star tetrahedra has nerve Q4, yielding β1=17; at r=3 the complex is the join of sixteen S0 and is S15, and at r>=4 a simplex. At r=2, freshly reconstructed 13,896 distinct simplices with f-vector (32,336,1568,3672,4512,2848,832,96) admit 6,943 staged toggle pairs; the full 66,304-arrow reversed Hasse DAG topologically sorts all 13,896 nodes. There are exactly one critical vertex, one 3-cell and eight 5-cells. The resulting CW model is 2-connected with one S3 as its 3-skeleton. Its possible eight 5-cell attachments lie in π4(S3)=Z/2, not determined by homology; an independently solved nontrivial 3-cocycle of support 95 has cup-one square of support 20 which is a 5-coboundary (rank δ4=2104), proving Sq2=0 and killing all suspended-Hopf attachments. The wedge S3∨(∨8 S5) follows from the standard detection theorem. Cellular chain groups give free integral homology. Positive homology degree supports of successive scales do not overlap, so persistence maps vanish in positive degrees; H0 follows from 32 isolated points becoming connected at r=1. All computations are exact for this enumerated finite complex, not a family-wide extrapolation.

value.rationale: The four-cube edge graph is a canonical 32-point rectified-tesseract metric with a genuine intermediate graph-power scale, not an arbitrary graph chosen by enumeration. A prior exact integer-homology computation explicitly could not determine whether its eight 5-cells attach by nontrivial suspended Hopf maps. The new nonzero mathematical information is the vanishing Steenrod obstruction, giving a complete integral homotopy splitting and therefore distinguishing this natural finite metric up to homotopy rather than just Betti rank. This motivated exact invariant and fully specified complete Rips filtration are useful benchmarks for topology of graph powers and the gap between Morse-cell/homology data and homotopy, even without an all-hypercube theorem. The r=1,3,4 stages and barcode endpoints individually are elementary and not independently claimed as deep novelty.

limitations: Applies exactly to L(Q4) with unit graph shortest-path metric and inclusive Rips threshold at all r>=0; says nothing about general n or Euclidean rectified tesseract metric.
The predecessor already published radius-two face vector, integral homology and the same matching critical counts; the fresh homotopy-classification information is the Sq2/attaching-map resolution.
Exact computations validate the full finite complex, not novelty or value and not proof of any infinite family.
The original METADATA.json first_public_date appears to correspond to a cited 2005 paper rather than the research result, so it is not reliable priority provenance.
No human expert or Lean formal verification is claimed; those pre-existing channels are preserved as not_performed.
